detail.const: Root hash, identifier and version must identify the same submitted object.
The assessment must fall within the requested time window.
An admitted source key must attest within its signed scope, operations and validity.
Non-active source versions cannot carry operative standing in this profile.
Source jurisdiction and scope must match the requested bounds exactly.
Source validity must contain the requested time window.
Every submitted source must be connected to the root; cycles and missing references are forbidden.
A separately admitted transition authority must sign the exact passage.
The warrant must contain the requested temporal and jurisdictional bounds.
The signed warrant must name inspectable evidence in the submitted graph.
COPY preserves content and epistemic status. COMPOSE retains distinct hash-addressed members without fusion.
All source qualifiers must survive unchanged; this profile permits no waiver.
Unknowns, their descriptions and blocked operations must survive unchanged.
No target operation may exceed its parents or the exact transition grant.
The requested operation must survive every source, warrant and unresolved blocking unknown.
